name: @soth/sdk-edge
description: SOTH SDK for edge runtimes (Cloudflare Workers, Vercel Edge, Deno Deploy, Fastly Compute) — WASM-backed.

scripts.build:wasm: cargo build -p soth-sdk-core --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release --no-default-features && cp ../../target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/soth_sdk_core.wasm wasm/
scripts.test: echo 'edge runtime tests run via wrangler / vercel deploy; see README' && exit 0
